name: server-data-table
title: Server Data Table
description: A DataTable over a PageSource: the server filters, sorts and pages; page numbers, previous and next, or load more follow what the source gives; DataState covers loading, error with retry and empty; a polite status says "Showing 21–40 of 312" after each load; filters, sort and page can live in the URL.
docs: `<ServerDataTable label source columns filters labels={{ errorTitle, retry, emptyTitle }} />`. Columns are DataTable columns; `sortField` sorts one on the server, and `sortMode="multi"` adds a column with Shift+click. `navigation="auto"` shows page numbers with an exact total (or the source's `fetchTotal`), previous and next with an estimate or only `hasMore`, and load more for a cursor; `"infinite"` also loads when the end scrolls into view, beside the button. `pageSize` (25) and `pageSizes` (`[10, 25, 50, 100]`, capped by the source's `maxPageSize`) show a page size select. `filters` takes a `defineFilters` schema, `filterUi` picks the built-in filter UI: `"search"` (a `FilterSearch`, the default when the schema has a text field), `"chips"` (search and `FilterChips`) or `"panel"` (search and a `FilterPanelTrigger` that opens a `FilterPanel` beside the table, a bottom sheet on narrow screens), and `toolbar` composes your own from the parts. `urlState={hashUrlState()}` (or `historyUrlState()`, or `{ adapter, prefix, history, format }`) keeps filters, sort and page in readable params, and Back and Forward move through them. While a page loads its predecessor stays, marked `aria-busy`; it never shows empty while loading or after an error. The status says "Loading…" only once a load has taken 400 ms, and focus stays on the control pressed. Agents sort and page through the table (`sortBy`, `setPage`) and filter through the "{label} filters" group: `filter("Status", ["Open"])`, `clearFilters()`. Visible copy has no default: `errorTitle`, `retry` and `emptyTitle` are required; `labels.searchPlaceholder` writes the search box's placeholder ("Search {label}…"), control names default to English (`labels.pageSize`, `loadMore`, `range`…), and the page navigation is named "{label} pages" (`labels.pagination`) so two tables on a page keep distinct landmarks. Pass `controller` from `usePageController` to drive it from outside. Counts ("Showing 1,001–1,020 of 12,345"), the page sizes and the chips' numbers and dates follow the page's `<html lang>` through `useLocale`; `locale` overrides it, and `labels.range` receives it.
